## Product description
Elevate your traditional look with this stunning Kerala model pendant necklace from MITHRAS CANADA. Inspired by the rich jewellery heritage of South India, this beautifully crafted piece features five ornate shield-shaped pendants adorned with vibrant green enamel accents and delicate ruby-red floral centres, all set in a warm gold-toned finish. The intricate detailing and granulated beadwork reflect classic Kerala craftsmanship, making it a truly eye-catching accessory. The pendant is strung on a sleek, barely-there invisible chain that keeps the focus entirely on the centrepiece, giving it a modern yet traditional appeal. Secured with an adjustable hook-and-ring clasp, this necklace offers a comfortable and secure fit. Perfect for weddings, festivals, and cultural celebrations, this piece pairs beautifully with sarees, salwar suits, and traditional ethnic wear. A timeless addition to any jewellery collection.
